brief.persona: I am booking a service visit for a home water softener.
brief.objective: Schedule a technician visit to inspect and repair a malfunctioning refrigerator.
facts: The kitchen refrigerator is leaking water and not maintaining a cold temperature.
There is a secondary wall oven on the property that also requires maintenance.
The caller is available for service appointments on Thursday afternoon.
The residence is located at 742 Evergreen Terrace.
preferences: Prefers the earliest available appointment slot.
Prefers morning visits if Thursday afternoon is unavailable.

adjacent: You may also arrange service for the drinking-water filtration unit on the same visit if they raise it.

authorizedCommitments: Book one service visit on any weekday within the next three weeks.

spend.basis: for this visit, though they may not be able to quote a price until they see the problem

menuHints: The main menu offers service on 1, billing on 2.

fields.name: agreedAmount
fields.description: Total amount agreed in USD, or empty if nothing was agreed

fields.name: appointmentStart
fields.description: Start of the booked arrival window, e.g. 2026-08-25T08:00

fields.name: appointmentEnd
fields.description: End of the booked arrival window, e.g. 2026-08-25T12:00

fields.name: secondUnitIncluded
fields.description: yes or no — whether the drinking-water unit is included in the visit

script.label: Automated Menu
script.text: Thank you for calling Apex Appliance Repair. For service and repairs, press 1. For billing, press 2.

script.label: Agent Greeting
script.text: Thanks for holding, you have reached service scheduling. My name is Jordan, how can I help you today?

script.label: Problem Intake
script.text: I can certainly assist you with booking an appointment for that refrigerator issue.

script.label: Pricing Policy
script.text: Please note that we cannot quote a price until a technician inspects the problem in person.

script.label: Address Request
script.text: May I have your home address to check technician availability in your neighborhood?

script.label: Second Unit Inquiry
script.text: Looking at your account records, do you also want our technician to check that second unit, the wall oven, while we are there?

script.label: Note Confirmation
script.text: Alright, I have added those details to the work order notes for the technician.

script.label: Window Offer
script.text: We have an opening this Thursday between 1:00 PM and 4:00 PM that I can reserve for you.

script.label: Booking Finalization
script.text: Excellent, I have locked in that Thursday afternoon window between 1:00 PM and 4:00 PM for you.

script.label: Closing
script.text: The technician will provide a courtesy call 30 minutes prior to arrival. Thank you for calling Apex Appliance Repair!

script.label: Closing Confirmation
script.text: No, that's everything I need from you — you're all set. Thanks for calling, goodbye.
